plan: My value is $34. To maximize profit, I want to win only if my bid allows positive earnings. Since values are independently drawn, I'll bid strategically near my value. A bid around $25-$30 gives me potential profit margin. I'll aim to underbid my full value to create surplus. Other bidders are rational, so they'll also bid below their true value. I'll choose a bid that balances winning probability with profit potential.

With a private value of $28, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a strategic bidding approach. I want to bid high enough to have a good chance of winning, but not so high that I lose money if I win. A bid around my value - slightly above the midpoint seems rational. This allows some buffer for potential competition while protecting my potential earnings.

I'll aim to bid strategically, anticipating rational behavior from other bidders.
